''See also: [[Underlord Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|An Underlord is a high-ranking [[sacred artist]] who has advanced beyond the [[Truegold]] realm. This progression requires clearing three distinct stages, beginning with opening a space within one's soul and eventually involving the manifestation of [[soulfire]]. Reaching this stage is a rare feat that allows an individual to transcend common logic, often granting them immense power and Authority{{!}}authority. For example, in the [[Blackflame Empire]], Underlords are treated with extreme respect, similar to royalty, and their presence can influence entire alliances. Physically, an Underlord possesses a significantly more durable body than those in lower ranks; specifically, the [[Steelborn body]] is noted as being exceptionally strong once this stage is reached. Their sensory perception is also vastly expanded, allowing them to hear and see much more than those at the [[Gold]] or [[Truegold]] levels. While they are incredibly powerful—capable of commanding vast territories like emperors or surviving attacks that would destroy lesser artists—they remain below the power of Overlords and Archlord{{!}}Archlords. In some cases, an Underlord's [[advancement]] is tied to a personal [[revelation]] regarding why they first began practicing the [[sacred arts]].}}

While this title represents a distant dream for ordinary [[Iron]] practitioners, its production once allowed the [[Jai clan]] to rise to prominence. == Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The Underlord is a powerful rank of individual that possesses the ability to weave and hoard [[soulfire]] for use during emergencies. This status is held by [[Eithan]], whom [[Yerin]] addresses by his title. It was the Underlord who caused the death of Sandviper Kral{{!}}Kral and later raised a white spear into the sky. Additionally, the Underlord was someone whom [[Fisher Gesha]] claimed was neglecting [[Lindon]]'s education and instructed [[Lindon]] to keep her assistance a secret from them.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The Underlord represents a powerful rank of [[advancement]] that requires the complete remaking of an individual's body and [[spirit]]. To reach this stage, a practitioner must master themselves, sense the unity of [[aura]] to master their surroundings, and discover their personal reason for practicing the [[sacred arts]]. This process is achieved through transformative [[resonance]], which burns away the old body and [[spirit]] to forge a new one. While [[Lindon]] has not yet reached this level, he noted that [[Yerin]] possessed the potential for it, and characters like Prince Seishen Kiro{{!}}Kiro already possess Underlord bodies. During a confrontation involving an Emperor's ship, thirteen of the sixteen known Underlords gathered on a [[cloudship]] deck, with several dashing through trees to launch [[Striker techniques]], though Truegold{{!}}Truegolds remain capable of standing up to them.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">14</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Lindon]] suggested [[Yerin]] would be an [[Underlord]] if she had his chances.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Reaching [[Underlord]] involves three steps: mastering yourself, mastering the world around you, and connecting to the world.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5">''Underlord'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The second step to reaching [[Underlord]] is sensing the unity of [[aura]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The third step to reaching [[Underlord]] is discovering one's reason for practicing the [[sacred arts]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|An [[Underlord]] is a stage achieved by burning away one's old body and [[spirit]] through transformative [[resonance]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9">''Underlord'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The opponent was a lone [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9" />}}</li>

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Attaining the rank of Underlord grants an individual the ability to cast their senses across much wider and farther distances. During the selection process for the main Akura prime team{{!}}Akura team, sixteen young Underlords were identified as candidates. The trials also featured a gold [[dragon]] possessing the power of an Underlord, as well as a man in the second trial who revealed his [[spirit]] held that same rank. While fifteen young Underlords eventually gathered in the center of the arena, two Underlords were observed bowing.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Underlord stage represents a specific [[revelation]] achieved by seeing oneself clearly, serving as a level of power that Ziel of the Wasteland{{!}}Ziel might accept if he is unable to reclaim [[Archlord]] status. These individuals, such as the [[Ninecloud]] [[peacekeepers]] and the two students observing the [[Sage]], possess the ability to hover upon Thousand-Mile Cloud{{!}}Thousand-Mile Clouds. To advance through this rank, an Underlord must condense their [[soulfire]] to fill themselves with it, pushing their [[madra]] to the absolute peak their souls can contain. Those at this level are capable of walking directly up to a [[Dreadgod]], and their Authority{{!}}authority is such that Archlord{{!}}Archlords or [[Heralds]] might choose not to interfere when an Underlord has someone in their grip.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Underlord{{!}}Underlords hover on Thousand-Mile Cloud{{!}}Thousand-Mile Clouds.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Underlord{{!}}Underlords advance by condensing their [[soulfire]], filling themselves with it, and pushing their [[madra]] to the peak of power their souls can contain.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Underlord]] is a stage or [[revelation]] [[Lindon]] has achieved.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c8">''Wintersteel'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
